glossary.ja: ディストーションフィールド
glossary.role: Nadesico's gravity-wave barrier; also the Aestivalis/Nadesico-unit defensive weapon in the tutorial.
Modified Gun Ark with an evolving Guardian System and fallen-angel styling; Marina's unit while with the Rainen side.
Nergal mass-produced mecha; used alone and in エステバリス隊 (Aestivalis squad/team).
The aura energy of a pilot; also the name of a Dunbine-family ability that multiplies attack power for a while (Weapon 6).
Surname of Akito Tenkawa; used alone (テンカワ君, テンカワ機 = Tenkawa's unit).

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness

glossary.role: Holy Warrior from a ranching family near Dallas, Texas; resistance pilot (House Givun); pilots Dunbine in ACE2
glossary.personality: Confident, kind and level-headed. A skilled pilot who first meets Sho as an enemy and talks him into questioning Drake. She loves Sho and wishes he would admit his feelings.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: Admiral of the United Earth forces (Third Fleet); Yurika's father; senior UESF commander in PoD
glossary.personality: Doting, emotional father; stern but decent commander

glossary.role: Earth's name for the unknown Jovian enemy (actually the Jovian Federation, 木連).

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: TV: cook and Aestivalis pilot of the Nadesico, a Class-A Boson Jumper. PoD: the "Prince of Darkness", Black Sarena pilot hunting the Martian Successors
glossary.personality: TV: kind, reluctant and insecure Gekiganger fan who wants to be a cook. PoD: cold, grim and vengeful after experiments destroyed his senses

glossary.role: Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: Queen of the Kingdom of Na; commands the aura battleship Gran-Garan; gives Sho the Billbine
glossary.personality: Serene, dignified young queen with strong Aura Power and a sense of duty to all of Byston Well. Calm but resolute.

glossary.role: American Holy Warrior summoned with Sho; fights for Drake and later Bishot Hate; pilots Wryneck in ACE2
glossary.personality: Brash and proud. At first he treats Byston Well as a game, then becomes obsessed with beating Sho to save his pride. Makes poor choices.

glossary.role: Surname of Jiro Yamada (who calls himself Gai Daigoji); used alone (ヤマダさん).

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: Captain of the ND-001 Nadesico; Akito's childhood friend and later wife; prisoner of the Martian Successors in PoD
glossary.personality: Cheerful, airheaded and clingy toward Akito, but a genuinely brilliant tactician

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: TV: operator/science officer of the Nadesico. PoD: Lieutenant Commander, captain of the Nadesico B ("Electronic Fairy")
glossary.personality: Deadpan, cool, blunt child prodigy (catchphrase "bunch of fools"); slowly warms to the crew

report.translator_summary: Translated batch op10_02 covering the climax of Phase 2 (Sho and Marvel vs Todd Guinness and Byston Well forces, subsequent boarding of Albion) and Phase 3 (Sinapus tactical briefing, Albion hailing Nadesico, Admiral Misumaru confronting Yurika over comms, warning shots lowering Nadesico's phase engine and Distortion Field, and Gai Daigoji / Akito scrambling in their Aestivalis units while Tak recognizes Gekiganger 3). Maintained character personalities: deadpan Ruri, excitable Yurika, hot-blooded Gai, and doting/authoritative Admiral Misumaru.
report.rows_examined: op10_01, op10_02, context_before (m6102#21-32), slice rows (m6102#33-62, brief63075#2-4, m6103#0-48), and context_after (m6103#49-60).

uncertainties.issue: Line 'この地上人ども、手強いぞ！' translated with standard Dunbine lore term 'Upper Earthers' for 地上人 (people from the Earth surface above Byston Well).
Cutscene transition lines with <on()>/<off()> between Phase 2 and 3: Ruri notes Jovian Lizards withdrawing while Sho and Marvel experience an Aura/space warp resonance before arriving at Albion.
Tak murmuring about having watched Gekiganger as a child, setting up the comedic ideological dispute with Gai Daigoji in the following lines.
